name: Tephra-Ward
specific_features: Automated beacon network (mining consortium hazard warnings, active)
description: Tephra-Ward burns under a sky the color of a healing bruise, its surface stitched with lava rivers and supervolcano calderas wide as small seas. The Ashfall Rift runs four thousand kilometers across the northern hemisphere, a wound of glowing orange where the planet's mantle lies bare to space.

The air is unbreathable sulfur haze that eats exposed seals and turns daylight a deep amber. Ground tremor is constant, a low note felt in the teeth more than heard, and ash falls in slow grey snow across everything. At night the rift lights the clouds from below like a furnace door left open.

The Kessler Mining Combine sank deep shafts along the rift to trace an exotic matter vein worth more than most systems, until their extraction charges ignited it. The vein did not explode; it caught, and has burned down through the mantle for six years now, waking volcanoes along the entire rift and throwing radiation plumes into every eruption column. The Combine abandoned the works mid-shift and bought the quarantine decree before the dust settled.

Consortium beacons ring the rift on automated towers built to survive the quakes, warning traffic away from fallout corridors and buried equipment alike. Independent crews whisper that the burning vein is stabilizing into something harvestable, and that Kessler's hasty evacuation left survey data and men behind in equal measure.
